tool_plan_template.description: Fetch the latest FII/DII flow trends, market regime, breadth, and index data to assess the current market context.

sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today, fii_net_5d, dii_net_5d, flow_signal, fii_trend, dii_trend
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence, days_in_regime
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.regime_history)
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, advances, declines, net_ad, market_sentiment
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM breadth.market_daily)
),
latest_index AS (
    SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, change_pct, trend_signal
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)
      AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT l.trade_date, lf.fii_net_today, lf.dii_net_today, lf.flow_signal, lr.regime, lr.confidence, lb.advances,
       lb.declines, lb.net_ad, lb.market_sentiment, li.close, li.change_pct, li.trend_signal
FROM latest_flows lf
JOIN latest_regime lr ON lf.trade_date = lr.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth lb ON lf.trade_date = lb.trade_date
JOIN latest_index li ON lf.trade_date = li.trade_date;

validation_rules: Ensure all components (flows, regime, breadth, index) have the same latest trade date.
Confirm index symbol is 'Nifty 50'.
